versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00218, SRS_BSW_00347 signature if swImplPolicy of the Trigger is not set to queued : void SchM_Trigger_<bsnp>[_<vi>_<ai>]_<name>() signature if swImplPolicy of the Trigger is set to queued : Std_ReturnType SchM_Trigger_<bsnp>[_<vi>_<ai>]_<name>() Where here 913 of 1609 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_CP_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R25-11 <bsnp> is the BSW Scheduler Name Prefix according [SWS_Rte_07593] and [SWS_Rte_07594], <vi> is the vendorId of the calling BSW module, <ai> vendorApiInfix of the calling BSW module and <name> is the released ( releasedTrigger ) Trigger name. The sub part in squared brackets [_<vi>_<ai>] is omitted if no vendorApiInfix is defined for the Basic Software Module . See [SWS_Rte_07528].
